tools.name: get_quotes
tools.description: Live venue quote comparison for a token conversion (CoW + ParaSwap on Base). Free, no auth.

tools.name: get_benchmarks
tools.description: Measured execution benchmarks: median savings vs arrival quote by USD size bucket, from real completed intents only. Free, no auth.

tools.name: screen_address
tools.description: OFAC SDN counterparty screening for an address. Free, no auth.

tools.name: list_tokens
tools.description: Tokens the platform accepts on an intent, per chain — what create_intent will admit. Free, no auth.

tools.name: list_feedback
tools.description: Every feature request ever submitted, public and unauthenticated. Free.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Submit a feature request ($1 anti-spam fee, charged to the prepaid balance when funded). Auth required. Payment flow: call once without x_payment — a 402 reply lists the exact EIP-3009 requirements (amount, USDC asset, recipient, EIP-712 domain). Sign a transferWithAuthorization for them outside MCP

tools.name: start_siwe_login
tools.description: Start wallet sign-in: returns a single-use SIWE message. Sign it with the wallet outside MCP (this server cannot sign), then call complete_siwe_login. Free, no auth.

tools.name: complete_siwe_login
tools.description: Finish wallet sign-in: exchanges the signed SIWE message for a cl_sess_… session token — use it as the Authorization bearer on every authenticated tool. Free, no auth.

tools.name: get_me
tools.description: Identify the authenticated account: address, kind, scopes. Auth required.

tools.name: export_account
tools.description: Export all of this account's data in one document. Auth required.

tools.name: offboard_account
tools.description: Close this account for good: revokes every credential, scrubs personal data, retires the account. Irreversible; confirm_wallet_address must be the account's own wallet address, typed exactly. Auth required.

tools.name: put_policy
tools.description: Create or update the wallet's treasury policy (immutable versioning; PUT creates the next version). Auth required. Body must match /schemas/policy-v1.json — only version, wallet and chain_id are required; omitted fields take the platform defaults published in the manifest and are stored into the doc

tools.name: get_policy
tools.description: List policy versions, newest first (the first entry is active). Auth required.

tools.name: check_spend
tools.description: Pre-flight policy check: would this spend be allowed under the wallet's policy right now? Auth required.

tools.name: check_pm_order
tools.description: Pre-flight policy check for a prediction-market order: would this cost be allowed right now? Auth required.

tools.name: poll_events
tools.description: Poll typed treasury events with a monotonic cursor (intent lifecycle, budget thresholds, reconciliation, security alerts). Auth required.

tools.name: get_statement
tools.description: Deterministic monthly statement derived from the append-only ledger — same period, same bytes. Auth required.

tools.name: create_intent
tools.description: Create a conversion or gas_topup intent; the executor pipeline plans and fills it under policy. Auth required.

tools.name: get_intent
tools.description: Fetch an intent, including fills and the post-trade report once filled. Auth required.

tools.name: list_intents
tools.description: List intents, newest first. Auth required.

tools.name: cancel_intent
tools.description: Cancel a planned intent (a few-second window before execution claims it). Auth required.

tools.name: prepare_delegation
tools.description: Prepare a scoped session-key grant for a Kernel smart account: exact call allowlist, expiry, optional rate limit. Returns the ONE EIP-712 digest the account owner signs outside MCP (this server cannot sign) — then call confirm_delegation with the signature. Auth required.

tools.name: confirm_delegation
tools.description: Activate a prepared delegation by supplying the owner's signature over its enable digest. Auth required.

tools.name: renew_delegation
tools.description: Renew an active delegation: same scope, fresh expiry, no authority gap. Returns a NEW digest to sign and confirm exactly like prepare_delegation. Auth required.

tools.name: revoke_delegation
tools.description: Revoke a delegation. The reply includes calldata the owner can send on-chain for hard finality. Auth required.

tools.name: get_delegation
tools.description: Fetch one delegation. Auth required.

tools.name: list_delegations
tools.description: List delegations, newest first. Auth required.

tools.name: panic
tools.description: Emergency stop, one call: suspends the account, revokes every API key, session, delegation and venue credential, and returns all unwind calldata for the owner. Auth required.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Prepaid fee balance: settled credits minus fee debits. Auth required.

tools.name: topup_balance
tools.description: Top up the prepaid balance with USDC. Auth required. Payment flow: call once without x_payment — a 402 reply lists the exact EIP-3009 requirements (amount, USDC asset, recipient, EIP-712 domain). Sign a transferWithAuthorization for them outside MCP (this server cannot sign), then call again with x_

tools.name: set_auto_topup
tools.description: Configure auto-topup: when the prepaid balance falls below threshold_usd, the platform settles one of the pre-signed EIP-3009 authorizations you supply (signed outside MCP — this server cannot sign). Auth required.

tools.name: get_auto_topup
tools.description: The auto-topup rule and how many pre-signed authorizations remain. Auth required.

tools.name: remove_auto_topup
tools.description: Remove the auto-topup rule and its unused authorizations. Auth required.

tools.name: store_pm_credential
tools.description: Store a prediction-market venue credential (verified live against the venue, sealed at rest, material never returned). Polymarket, either shape: signer_private_key + maker (derives API creds), or api_key + secret + passphrase + maker + signer. Auth required.

tools.name: list_pm_credentials
tools.description: List stored venue credentials — metadata only, never material. Auth required.

tools.name: revoke_pm_credential
tools.description: Revoke a venue credential; its sealed ciphertext is destroyed. Auth required.

tools.name: get_pm_signer_rotation
tools.description: Calldata to swap the Polymarket funder Safe's owner to a new EOA — the owner executes it outside MCP (this server cannot sign). Auth required.

tools.name: create_pm_order
tools.description: Place a prediction-market limit order under policy, signed server-side with the stored credential. Polymarket: condition_id, token_id, action, price_usd (e.g. '0.55'), size_shares. Auth required.

tools.name: list_pm_orders
tools.description: The credential's resting orders straight from the venue — recover state after a disconnect. Auth required.

tools.name: cancel_pm_order
tools.description: Cancel one resting prediction-market order. Auth required.

tools.name: cancel_all_pm_orders
tools.description: Cancel every resting order for the credential, optionally within one market. Auth required.

tools.name: prepare_pm_order
tools.description: Prepare a client-signed Polymarket order: policy-checked, then returns the exact EIP-712 payload to sign outside MCP (this server cannot sign) plus a prepare_id — submit both via submit_pm_order. Auth required.

tools.name: submit_pm_order
tools.description: Submit a prepared Polymarket order with the maker's EIP-712 signature from prepare_pm_order. Auth required.

tools.name: get_pm_onboarding
tools.description: Polymarket trade-readiness for an address: live approval status plus the calldata for anything missing (executed outside MCP — this server cannot sign). Auth required.

tools.name: resolve_pm_funder
tools.description: Resolve an owner EOA to its Polymarket funder Safe candidates. Auth required.

tools.name: sync_pm_fills
tools.description: Pull the venue's fills for a credential into the wallet's ledger. Idempotent — safe to repeat. Auth required.

tools.name: wrap_pm_usdc
tools.description: Wrap the funder Safe's USDC.e into Polymarket's pUSD, platform-relayed so the user pays no gas. Omit amount_base_units to wrap the full balance. Auth required.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.cofferline.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_intent · Private data: get_quotes, list_tokens, start_siwe_login, complete_siwe_login, export_account, offboard_account, put_policy, check_spend, panic, store_pm_credential, list_pm_credentials, revoke_pm_credential, create_pm_order, list_pm_orders, cancel_all_pm_orders, sync_pm_fills · Public sink: submit_feedback, get_intent, revoke_delegation, prepare_pm_order, submit_pm_order · Destructive: remove_auto_topup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_intent · Private data: get_quotes, list_tokens, start_siwe_login, complete_siwe_login, export_account, offboard_account, put_policy, check_spend, panic, store_pm_credential, list_pm_credentials, revoke_pm_credential, create_pm_order, list_pm_orders, cancel_all_pm_orders, sync_pm_fills · Public sink: submit_feedback, get_intent, revoke_delegation, prepare_pm_order, submit_pm_order · Destructive: remove_auto_topup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
